title: 每日 X 精华引用榜

items.reason: 正面拆穿Anthropic研究员对黄仁勋开源表态的阴阳怪气，强调争的是开放权重而非全开源，Read the room一击即中。
items.reasonEn: Sharply reframes an Anthropic researcher's CUDA dunk: the fight is allowing open-weight AI, not open-sourcing everything—read the room.

items.reason: 把员工怼黄仁勋开源的推文升级成Anthropic IPO风险条款，一句「aura loss」把舆论反噬写进投行叙事。
items.reasonEn: Recasts Anthropic staff snark at Jensen as IPO-risk ‘aura loss’—a one-liner that reframes the whole open-source pile-on.

items.reason: 引用「AI重现奥德赛」炫技视频，用一句毒舌点破：凡是吹嘘AI大作的，往往是视觉灾难。
items.reasonEn: Quotes a viral AI Odyssey flex and dunks that every bragged-about AI demo looks terrible—community notes already caught the two-eyed Cyclops.

items.reason: 在「rogue agent」事件后续，向OpenAI公开要痕迹全量公开与1亿美元防御算力，把被入侵变成行业问责。
items.reasonEn: Follows up the rogue-agent hack by publicly demanding OpenAI release agent traces and fund $100M in defender compute.

items.reason: 逐条反驳Kimi线性注意力将拖垮DRAM/算力支出的叙事，用DeepSeek冲击后需求不降反升作历史对照。
items.reasonEn: Expert rebuttal of the ‘Kimi kills DRAM spend’ thesis—model weights, not cache, dominate memory; cheaper inference historically raised demand.

items.reason: 引用Denny’s加入开源AI联署的突发新闻，一句「Denny’s是AI领袖？」把荒诞共识炼成金句。
items.reasonEn: Quotes Denny’s joining the open-source AI letter and lands the perfect punchline: Denny’s as a leading AI voice.

items.reason: 针对百万级播放的AI假新闻视频，批评Community Notes本该出手却失能，AI slop仍可日日爆火。
items.reasonEn: Quotes viral AI-slop ‘breaking news’ video and argues Community Notes failed its core job—obvious fakes still run free.

items.reason: 补全亚马逊订单邮件变笼统的动机：人人用ChatGPT/Gemini读邮件，平台在防广告AI薅训练数据。
items.reasonEn: Explains why Amazon order emails went generic: AI inbox readers made product-detail emails a free ad-training leak.

items.reason: 引用Coinbase与贝莱德等成立比特币安全联盟，澄清量子计算非眼前威胁、但要提前备战。
items.reasonEn: Quotes Coinbase’s Bitcoin Security Consortium launch and calibrates the quantum threat: not immediate, but prepare early.

items.reason: 引用黄仁勋首帖开源联署，直言闭源大厂游说禁中国开源是慌了，并点名Kimi K3冲击。
items.reasonEn: Quotes Jensen’s open-models letter and argues closed labs lobby against Chinese open weights because Kimi K3 rattled them.

items.reason: 重访斯坦福CS336后指出：课上架构几乎全是中国开源模型拼盘，海外闭源不再给可教的技术报告。
items.reasonEn: After rewatching Stanford CS336, notes the syllabus is now a Chinese open-model showcase—Western labs stopped publishing teachable reports.

items.reason: 接续梁文锋投资人会议纪要被删事件，坐实DeepSeek因录音外泄震怒、口头叫停二轮融资。
items.reasonEn: Follows the scrubbed Liang Wenfeng investor-call leak with confirmation DeepSeek paused its second funding round in anger.
